# mistershell_local_auth_policy (Data Source)

Reads existing backend-owned configuration without changing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_local_auth_policy" "existing" {
  id = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing numeric ID, stable configuration key, or local.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) ID must be local. configuration = { mfa_method = none or totp }. Email MFA and adoption of an email baseline require interactive proof and cannot be managed. Masked secrets are returned as null.
